title: driftkings
author: driftkings
changelog: Adopt the revised in-game settings as defaults; align carousel statistic columns and icon rows with consistent font aliases.
Apply reticle-size correction consistently to artillery trajectory view and ballistic dispersion contours, preserving native impact positions and replay data.
Fix WN8 fallback averages and refresh expected-value caches after data updates.
Reject invalid statistics downloads while preserving the last usable cache; bound and close player-statistics responses.
Enable validation for develop, run every Gameface regression suite and make retry tests deterministic.
Remove the inactive hangar-efficiency panel and improve clock error diagnostics.
Center the minimap artillery aim in the camera frame at a fixed size and show it only in artillery and strategic modes.
Extend the minimap hull direction line to the map edge and document the {{cellsize}} map-size macro.

Add General settings and move the hangar clock there: clock.enabled and a list of positioned fields (text, shadow and background image) replace the size, background and single-format options; earlier clock settings are converted automatically.
Lay out clock text line by line like Flash, so negative leading places the weekday and date beside the time.
